lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-luminance spots are organized in a semi-regular grid; posterior to the gill slits, spots form vertical columns of 4-5 visible nodes with relatively uniform spacing between rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the circular blobs, creating a mesh-like appearance where the blobs act as intersection nodes between vertical and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal edge to dark shadows on the ventral edge of each ridge.
